info.name: OKKI Go Companies Emails API
info.description: OKKI Go is a B2B prospecting engine for AI agents and sales teams from Xiaoman (小满科技, an Alibaba company). Search global B2B companies, unlock company profiles and decision-maker contact emails, send batch or personalized cold outreach email (EDM), and track delivery — designed to be driven from AI agents via the provider-published OKKI Go Agent Skill. This OpenAPI was generated by API Evangelist from the provider's published API reference shipped inside the @okki-global/okki-go npm package (skill/references/api-reference.md, v1.3.4); endpoint paths, parameters, billing notes, and error semantics are taken verbatim from that document. Errors use RFC 7807 Problem Details. All authenticated endpoints share a 60 requests/minute rate limit.

item.name: Send batch outreach email (one template, many recipients)

request.description: Costs 1 EDM quota per recipient; max 100 recipients per request. Asynchronous — record task_id to track progress. Insufficient balance refunds all and returns 402.
